info.name: CareGuard QA - End-to-End API Regression
info.description: 按顺序运行的端到端回归集合：自动创建双角色账号、确认绑定，验证隐私隔离、情绪分类、提醒、联系人、告警和审计。

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('runId')) {
const runId = String(Date.now()).slice(-8);
pm.collectionVariables.set('runId', runId);
pm.collectionVariables.set('elderlyPhone', '139' + runId);
pm.collectionVariables.set('familyPhone', '137' + runId);
pm.collectionVariables.set('dueAt', new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString());
pm.test('Response time is below 2000 ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(2000); });
pm.test('Correlation ID is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Request-ID')).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('No server error', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500); });
pm.test('Service is healthy', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('ok'); });
pm.test('Database is ready', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().database).to.eql('connected'); });
pm.test('Elderly registration succeeds', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
var cgBody = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('elderlyToken', cgBody.access_token); pm.collectionVariables.set('elderlyId', cgBody.user.id);
pm.test('Phone is masked', () => { pm.expect(cgBody.user.phone_masked).to.match(/^139\*{4}\d{4}$/); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('elderlyPhone')); });
pm.test('Family registration succeeds', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
var cgBody = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('familyToken', cgBody.access_token); pm.collectionVariables.set('familyId', cgBody.user.id);
pm.test('Role is family', () => pm.expect(cgBody.user.role).to.eql('family'));

pm.test('Profile is protected and masked', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().role).to.eql('elderly'); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).not.to.have.property('password_hash'); });

var cgBody = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Invitation remains pending', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(cgBody.status).to.eql('pending'); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('linkId', cgBody.id);

pm.test('Pending invitation is visible to elderly', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get('linkId') && x.status === 'pending')).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Explicit consent activates the link', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('active'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().accepted_at).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('Link is active for family', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0].status).to.eql('active'); });

pm.test('Positive label and disclaimer returned', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().emotion).to.eql('positive'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().disclaimer).to.include('不构成医疗诊断'); });
pm.test('Neutral label returned', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().emotion).to.eql('neutral'); });
pm.test('Negative label returned', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().emotion).to.eql('negative'); });
pm.test('Second negative check-in succeeds', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

item.name: Create negative mood 3 and streak alert

exec: pm.test('Third negative check-in succeeds', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().emotion).to.eql('negative'); });

pm.test('High-attention phrase is flagged without diagnosis', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().is_high_risk).to.be.true; pm.expect(pm.response.json().emotion).to.eql('negative'); });
pm.test('Owner can see own raw text', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0].text).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Family reads labels but raw text is redacted

exec: pm.test('Every raw text field is redacted for family', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(pm.response.json().every(x => x.text === null)).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Three-class counts reconcile', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d.positive + d.neutral + d.negative).to.eql(d.total); });

var cgBody = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Linked family can create reminder', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(cgBody.reminder_type).to.eql('medication'); }); pm.collectionVariables.set('reminderId', cgBody.id);
pm.test('Created reminder is visible to owner', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get('reminderId'))).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Reminder is completed', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().is_completed).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Contact is masked at API boundary', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(d.phone_masked).to.eql('139****5678'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('13912345678'); });

pm.test('Contact list contains masked values only', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d[0].phone_masked).to.include('****'); pm.expect(d[0]).not.to.have.property('phone'); });

var cgBody = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Care alerts exist and do not leak raw text', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(cgBody.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('活着没意思'); }); var openAlert = cgBody.find(x => x.status === 'open'); if (openAlert) pm.collectionVariables.set('alertId', openAlert.id);

pm.test('Alert is acknowledged with timestamp', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('acknowledged'); pm.expect(d.acknowledged_at).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('Audit trail contains mood actions', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d.some(x => x.resource_type === 'mood')).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Portable export contains only owner identity', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(String(d.user.id)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('elderlyId'))); pm.expect(d).to.have.all.keys('export_version', 'user', 'moods', 'reminders', 'contacts'); });

pm.test('Model card declares three labels and medical exclusion', () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(d.labels).to.eql(['positive','neutral','negative']); pm.expect(d.out_of_scope).to.include('medical diagnosis'); pm.expect(d.known_limitations.length).to.be.above(0); });
